title: Roasted garlic asparagus
summary: Asparagus roasted hot with olive oil and garlic, finished with lemon zest, juice and flaky salt.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Toss the asparagus with the oil, salt and pepper on a rimmed sheet pan and spread in one layer.
Roast 6 minutes, then scatter the garlic over, toss and roast 4–6 minutes more, until the spears are tender-crisp and lightly browned and the garlic is golden. Thick spears need the longer time.
Move to a platter, grate over the lemon zest, sprinkle with the juice and flaky salt, and serve.
tips: Add the garlic partway through: sliced garlic burns and turns bitter if it roasts for the full time.

origin.history: Asparagus was cultivated and prized in ancient Rome; the Roman writer Cato gave instructions for growing it. Its short spring season made it a traditional Easter and spring vegetable across Europe, celebrated especially in Germany's white-asparagus season. Simply roasting it with oil and garlic is a modern home method.
